decisions.reason: The commission-accounting exception is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY excluding the first mint from commission totals.
The first-mint ticket exception and revised ticket-count rule are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records that mint #1 awards no ticket when no earlier NFT exists for random selection.
The metadata requirement applies to rewards that are actually allocated; the absence of a first-mint ticket creates no new metadata attribute or visibility rule.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records that mint #1 awards no commission when no existing NFT holder is available.
The accepted exception concerns a completed one-off first mint and is explicitly described as having no forward impact; it does not necessarily require changing the future-facing FAQ.
The first mint remains a successfully owned NFT; only its ticket and commission allocation are affected.
The first-mint reward exception does not change the sales-based countdown to the next prize draw.
The source decision changes first-mint ticket and commission accounting, not referral-count visibility.
Ticket and commission allocation for the first mint has no effect on NFT image or media rendering.
The first mint remains a completed mint and therefore does not change the rule that public mint statistics count successfully completed mints.
The source decision concerns the first mint's ticket and referral commission, not its prize-pool contribution or the display of prize-pool totals.
